identity.title: [v0.92][WP-11][runtime] Implement the first Memory Palace context-topology slice

values.summary: Extend and prove the existing WP-11 Memory Palace topology with identity/continuity gates, bounded deterministic selection, overflow, provenance, and redaction.

steps.action: Verify #5826, #5827, and ObsMem/trace evidence and inspect the exact existing Memory Palace packet schema before editing.
Integrate identity/continuity gates, canonical topology, bounded selection, overflow, provenance, temporal anchors, and fixtures.
Run focused integration, deterministic replay, stale/hash/continuity/redaction negatives, and platform portability lanes.
Resolve one bounded exact-head review and publish only with correct base and Closes #5828 linkage.

invariants: Same inputs and observation time produce byte-equivalent semantic topology output.
Selection remains bounded and records overflow instead of silently consuming beyond limits.
All loaded items pass identity, continuity, provenance, temporal, hash, and redaction gates.
risks: Schema drift could break existing Memory Palace packets.
Selection order or observation time could introduce nondeterminism.
Context fixtures could disclose private or host-specific paths.
stop_conditions: Any dependency or ObsMem/trace baseline is not currently proven.
An existing packet schema must change without an explicit migration.
The exact files collide with another live protected-path claim.
replan_triggers: The current packet schema cannot carry identity/continuity bindings compatibly.
Observed context-time semantics require a new deterministic input.
Review identifies an unbounded or unauthorized retrieval path.
